profiles.shortDescription: Geelen Counterflow develops counterflow dryers and coolers for feed, food and other bulk-processing applications.
fullDescription: Geelen Counterflow's official site identifies a Dutch process-equipment manufacturer founded in 1980.
Its documented portfolio covers counterflow coolers, dryers and combined drying-and-cooling systems for pellets, extrudates and other bulk products.

profiles.shortDescription: GEFA Processtechnik manufactures industrial valves and filtration equipment for process applications.
fullDescription: GEFA's official site documents a German process-technology manufacturer active since 1964.
The published range includes butterfly, ball, knife-gate and check valves together with filter systems for industrial media-control duties.

profiles.shortDescription: GEFEG-NECKAR develops electric motors, geared motors and customized drive systems for industrial equipment.
fullDescription: GEFEG-NECKAR's official site identifies a German manufacturer of compact electric drive systems.
Its documented product scope includes AC, DC and brushless motors, planetary and worm geared motors, encoders, brakes and application-specific drive assemblies.

profiles.shortDescription: GEHA develops and manufactures components and complete systems for industrial air-cooling installations.
fullDescription: GEHA's official site identifies a Dutch industrial-cooling equipment company operating since 1957.
Its product scope includes large fan rings, bearing blocks, louvre dampers, plenums, steel structures, drives and engineered upgrades for air-cooled heat-exchanger systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Gems Sensors & Controls manufactures level, pressure and flow sensors, switches and fluid-control products.
fullDescription: Gems Sensors & Controls' official site documents a sensing and control manufacturer with a history beginning in 1955.
The published portfolio covers liquid-level sensors and switches, pressure transducers and switches, flow sensors, solenoid valves and integrated fluid-control assemblies.

profiles.shortDescription: Genebre develops valves, fluid-control equipment and related products for industrial and building applications.
fullDescription: Genebre's official site identifies a Spanish fluid-control company established in 1981.
Its industrial portfolio includes ball, butterfly, gate, globe and check valves, actuators, control valves, fittings and accessories for liquid and gas systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Generac Mobile manufactures mobile light towers, generators and equipment for temporary power and worksite applications.
fullDescription: Generac's official mobile-products site documents a current business within Generac Power Systems.
The published portfolio includes mobile lighting towers, generators, battery energy-storage units, dust-suppression systems, pumps and heaters for construction and industrial worksites.

profiles.shortDescription: General Monitors is an MSA Safety brand for fixed gas and flame detection equipment used in hazardous areas.
fullDescription: MSA Safety's official product and certification material identifies General Monitors as a current gas- and flame-detection brand within MSA.
The documented scope includes combustible and toxic gas detectors, infrared and ultrasonic detection, flame detectors and fixed monitoring controllers.

profiles.shortDescription: Generalmatic manufactures pneumatic and hydraulic components for industrial automation and fluid-control systems.
fullDescription: Generalmatic's official site identifies an Italian fluid-power component manufacturer operating since 1985.
Its documented range includes solenoid and pneumatically operated valves, digital pneumatic valves, cylinders, regulators, quick couplings and hydraulic components.

profiles.shortDescription: Genie is a Terex brand for aerial work platforms, telehandlers and material-lifting equipment.
fullDescription: Terex's official Genie site documents a current access-equipment brand founded in 1966.
The published portfolio includes boom lifts, scissor lifts, vertical mast lifts, telehandlers, material lifts and accessories for elevated work and material handling.

profiles.shortDescription: GEORGII KOBOLD manufactures electric motors and customized drive solutions for industrial machinery and automation.
fullDescription: GEORGII KOBOLD's official site documents a German electric-drive manufacturer founded in 1924.
The published range covers asynchronous and synchronous motors, torque motors, brake motors, servo drives and application-specific motor and gearbox combinations.

profiles.shortDescription: GERNEP manufactures rotary labelling machines and integrated labelling systems for packaged products.
fullDescription: GERNEP's official site identifies a German labelling-machine manufacturer established in 1985.
Its documented portfolio includes self-adhesive, cold-glue, hot-melt and roll-fed labellers together with inspection, orientation and coding integrations.

profiles.shortDescription: Getinge develops medical and life-science equipment for surgery, intensive care, sterilization and contamination prevention.
fullDescription: Getinge's official corporate site identifies a Swedish medical-technology company founded in 1904.
Its documented portfolio includes operating-room systems, ventilators and critical-care equipment, sterilizers, washer-disinfectors, cleanroom and biopharmaceutical production technologies.

profiles.shortDescription: GfA ELEKTROMATEN manufactures drive units, controls and safety devices for industrial door systems.
fullDescription: GfA ELEKTROMATEN's official site identifies a German industrial-door drive manufacturer founded in 1954.
The documented range includes direct, chain, roller-shutter and sectional-door drives, door controls, safety brakes and accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: GGB is a Timken brand for plain bearings, bushings and tribological solutions used in industrial machinery.
fullDescription: GGB's official site documents a current plain-bearing technology brand within The Timken Company.
Its published portfolio includes metal-polymer, fibre-reinforced composite, bimetal and solid-polymer bearings, thrust washers, bearing plates and customized tribological components.

profiles.shortDescription: GH Induction develops induction-heating generators, machines, coils and automated thermal-process systems.
fullDescription: GH Induction's official site identifies a manufacturer and integrator of industrial induction-heating equipment.
The documented portfolio includes power generators, induction coils, heat-treatment machines, turnkey automation and systems for brazing, hardening, annealing and other thermal processes.

profiles.shortDescription: GHIM Hydraulics designs and manufactures hydraulic power packs, pumps, cylinders, valves and mechanical components.
fullDescription: GHIM Hydraulics' official site identifies an Italian designer and manufacturer of hydraulic and mechanical components.

profiles.shortDescription: Giacomini manufactures hydronic valves, controls and distribution systems for heating, cooling and water applications.
fullDescription: Giacomini's official site identifies an Italian hydronic-systems manufacturer founded in 1951.

Its published range includes radiator valves, manifolds, balancing and control valves, radiant heating and cooling systems, metering products and components for domestic-water and fire-protection networks.

profiles.shortDescription: Gigasense develops force-measurement, overload-protection and safety products for lifting and industrial applications.
fullDescription: Gigasense's official site documents a Swedish measurement and industrial-safety equipment manufacturer.
The published range includes dynamometers, load cells, overload guards, wire-rope monitors and related systems for cranes, mining and material handling.

profiles.shortDescription: GIPO manufactures mobile crushing, screening and material-processing equipment for quarrying, recycling and construction.
fullDescription: GIPO's official site identifies a Swiss manufacturer of tracked material-processing equipment founded in 1982.
Its portfolio includes mobile impact and jaw crushers, screening plants, combined crusher-screen systems and tracked conveyors.

profiles.shortDescription: Girol designs and manufactures rotary unions and swivel joints for industrial fluid-transfer applications.
fullDescription: Girol's official site identifies an Italian rotary-union manufacturer established as a specialist company in 2006.
Its documented range covers rotary unions for water, oil, air, steam and multiple media, including products for machine tools, steel mills and continuous-casting equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Giuliani Anello is a Watts product line for gas and liquid-fuel control components used in burner and thermal systems.
fullDescription: Watts' official site identifies Giuliani Anello as a current line of components for oil and gas systems.
The documented portfolio includes gas filters, pressure regulators, shut-off and relief valves, valve proving equipment and gas-train components for thermal plants.

profiles.shortDescription: GKS-PERFEKT manufactures hydraulic lifting equipment and machine-moving skates for positioning heavy loads.
fullDescription: GKS-PERFEKT's official site documents a German lifting and transport-equipment manufacturer founded in 1967.
The published range includes hydraulic toe jacks, machine skates, tandem transport systems, rotating dollies and remote-controlled transport platforms.

profiles.shortDescription: GLAMA manufactures heavy-duty industrial vehicles and handling machines for metallurgical plants and process industries.
fullDescription: GLAMA's official site identifies a German special-purpose machinery manufacturer founded in 1961.

profiles.shortDescription: Global Water Engineering designs and supplies industrial wastewater-treatment and biogas-recovery systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Glual Hydraulics designs and manufactures hydraulic cylinders, power units and integrated fluid-power systems.
fullDescription: Glual Hydraulics' official site documents a Spanish hydraulic-systems manufacturer founded in 1969.

profiles.shortDescription: GNB is an Exide Technologies brand for motive-power and network-power batteries and charging systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Godwin is a Xylem brand for portable self-priming pumps used in dewatering, wastewater and emergency pumping.

profiles.shortDescription: Goizper develops power-transmission components, industrial automation solutions and spraying equipment.
fullDescription: Goizper's official group site identifies a Spanish cooperative established in 1959.

profiles.shortDescription: Gotec manufactures electromagnetic pumps, solenoids and fluid-handling components for industrial equipment.
fullDescription: Gotec's official site identifies a Swiss electromagnetic pump manufacturer founded in 1964.

profiles.shortDescription: GOW-MAC Instrument manufactures gas chromatographs, gas analysers and detectors for laboratory and process measurement.
fullDescription: GOW-MAC's official site documents a US analytical-instrument manufacturer founded in 1935.

profiles.shortDescription: Gram Equipment manufactures production lines and machines for industrial ice-cream manufacturing.
fullDescription: Gram Equipment's official site identifies a Danish food-processing equipment manufacturer with roots dating to 1901.
Its documented portfolio includes extrusion, moulding and filling lines, freezers, ingredient feeders, stick-product systems, wrapping integration and complete ice-cream production plants.

profiles.shortDescription: GRAMMER manufactures seating systems and interior components for commercial vehicles, off-road equipment and passenger vehicles.
fullDescription: GRAMMER's official corporate site identifies a German manufacturer of vehicle seating and interior systems founded in 1954.

Its product scope covers driver and passenger seats for trucks, buses, agricultural and construction machinery, together with headrests, armrests, centre consoles and other automotive interior components.

profiles.shortDescription: Gravograph is a Gravotech brand for engraving, marking and cutting machines, software and materials.
fullDescription: Gravotech's official site documents Gravograph as part of its current engraving and permanent-marking portfolio.
The published range includes mechanical engraving machines, laser systems, dot-peen and scribing markers, engraving software, cutters and engraving materials.

profiles.shortDescription: Greenlee is an Emerson brand for professional electrical, utility and communications tools and test equipment.
fullDescription: Greenlee's official site documents a current professional-tools brand within Emerson with origins in 1862.

profiles.shortDescription: Green Pumps manufactures centrifugal pumps for corrosive, hazardous and demanding industrial fluids.
fullDescription: Green Pumps' official site identifies an Italian industrial-pump manufacturer.
Its documented range includes magnetic-drive pumps, mechanically sealed centrifugal pumps, vertical pumps and special executions in metallic and non-metallic materials.

profiles.shortDescription: GREIN manufactures optoelectronic and pressure-sensitive safety devices for guarding industrial machinery.
fullDescription: GREIN's official company profile documents an Italian industrial-electronics business founded in 1965 that began manufacturing safeguarding devices in 1978.

profiles.shortDescription: Griffco Valve manufactures pressure-control and flow-accessory products for chemical-feed and metering-pump systems.
